scene: Wind whips your beanie as the flying sidecar zooms over neon towers.
beats: The dial hums with static, tuning right into the flashing storefront as the sidecar glides inside and the doors slide open.
The mechanical pigeon drops a warm, glowing vacuum tube into your lap just as the motorbike rolls inside and the garage doors open.
You find a coiled copper wire that hums cheerfully, matching the shop's neon glow as the sidecar halts inside and the bay doors open.
picture: A flat side view inside the flying sidecar motorbike. Far left: dashboard with a glowing brass dial. Centre: the player sits inside, gripping the padded rim beside a canvas sack on the floor. Right: the goggled motorcycle driver sits astride, while a clockwork pigeon flaps just beyond.
shown: A brass tuning dial clicks quietly on the dashboard on the far left.
A clockwork pigeon glides steadily beside the open sidecar on the right.
A rumpled canvas tool sack sits unopened on the floor at the centre.

after.label: Step off at Midnight Radio Repair
Stay on
after.beat: You wave Midnight Radio Repair goodbye as a neon banner ruffles your beanie. At the line's end, you board the clanking bridge crawler, trundling toward the turning cog towers of bustling Gear Bridge.
